image_description: A low-resolution, vintage-style photograph of a massive, light-colored limestone or chalk cliff face rising steeply against a clear blue sky. The rock surface is textured with horizontal stratification and weathering. Dark green vegetation (trees and shrubs) clings to the top ridge and the lower left slope. A distinct overhang or cave-like recess is visible in the lower central part of the cliff.
